headlines.title: Longest home run of the day: 391 ft
headlines.blurb: David Hamilton homers (2) on a fly ball to right center field. (102.0 mph off the bat).

headlines.title: Bryce Miller traded from the Seattle Mariners to the Kansas City Royals
headlines.blurb: Seattle Mariners traded RHP Bryce Miller, RHP Logan Evans and LHP José A. Ferrer to Kansas City Royals for 3B Maikel Garcia, RHP L.P. Langevin and RHP James McArthur.

headlines.title: Jack Pineda traded from the Kansas City Royals to the Boston Red Sox
headlines.blurb: Boston Red Sox traded RHP Angel Bastardo to Kansas City Royals for SS Jack Pineda.

headlines.title: Cam Robinson traded from the Tigres del Licey to the Toros del Este
headlines.blurb: Tigres del Licey traded RHP Cam Robinson and RHP Misael Tamarez to Toros del Este.

headlines.title: Kenya Huggins traded from the Athletics to the Boston Red Sox
headlines.blurb: Boston Red Sox traded LHP Raymond Burgos to Athletics for RHP Kenya Huggins.

headlines.title: Yaqui Rivera traded from the Baltimore Orioles to the Athletics
headlines.blurb: Baltimore Orioles traded RHP Yaqui Rivera to Athletics for RHP Josiah Romeo.

headlines.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong leads MLB with 45 home runs
headlines.blurb: The current league home run leader this season, per MLB's own live stats.
